teaser: You are standing at the sink, scrubbing a pan that was already clean, because stopping before the right moment feels unfinished. Life path 11 carries that pull toward something past the ordinary, and INFJ carries the same quiet insistence on meaning before noise. The crossing is not simply visionary and sensitive; it is a person who feels the larger pattern first and goes looking for proof after, who sets the bar high for a self that already works too hard, and who can mistake exhaustion for a failure to understand.
